title: The Long Watch
summary: Osric Hale says a Watch post is a place you stand when nobody comes to relieve you. Hold the Canal Locks' Sluice that long, and he'll teach your fighters to get their breath back (the fighter's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Go down to the Canal Locks' second floor and hold the Sluice, the hall at the far end, for ten waves.

ready: Go back to Osric Hale at his Watch post in Thornwick.
done: Osric taught your fighters Second Wind, and wrote down that he had.
